title: Controllers & assignments UI
description: No UI for footswitch/EXP/controller assignment (engine has CLI patch ops since core 0.58). Parity: FS bypass assign (latching/momentary, merge/replace), EXP bypass (position/wait/toe/heel), MIDI bypass, param->controller learn, min/max drag incl reverse, sources (stomp/ext-FS/triggers/EXP/MIDI/XY), stomp label+LED colour, swap stomps, clear, XY controller+rubber-band. Manual: live/bypass-and-controller-assign.

title: Snapshots management UI
description: device live follows snapshot switches but has no snapshot EDITING UI. Parity: 8 snapshots/preset; per-snapshot capture of block bypass + snapshot-controlled params + tempo; enable/disable snapshot control per param (white-value toggle); per-block Snapshots-Set-Bypass exclude; rename+color; copy/paste snapshot; swap; Discard-Edits mode. Engine ground already solved (dense @enabled, value==active, snapshot-bypass assignment). Manual: live/snapshots. See docs/parity/stadium-app-parity.md.

title: Signal-flow editor parity (device live chain editor)
description:
Bring the `device live` chain editor from "read-the-structure, turn-the-knobs" up to the Stadium Edit app's full SIGNAL-FLOW EDITOR.

CURRENT STATE: device live renders the loaded tone as a signal chain (every block, inputs/outputs, parallel lanes between split/merge), every param a knob/switch/list, bypass per block, live writes heard immediately, hardware Save, follows the device, undo/redo, adjective-search knob highlighting.

GAP (what the Stadium editor does that we can't): no structural editing (add/remove/move/copy-paste blocks), no model browser / model swap, no split/merge/parallel creation, no dual-cab 2nd model, no input-source / output-level selection in-UI, no mono<->stereo conversion, no Focus View deep editors (amp lens/XY morph, cab mic placement + IR plot, graphic EQ drag, comp gain-reduction meter), harness settings (Trails) hidden.

Full parity checklist (blocks add/remove/move, model browser, parallel routing, dual-amp/dual-cab, inputs/outputs, mono/stereo, Focus View) lives in docs/parity/stadium-app-parity.md -> "EPIC — Signal-flow editor parity".

Manual: manuals.line6.com/en/helix-stadium/live/ signal-path-routing, display, the-focus-view, matrix-mixer.

This is the "editor bead" to take into a design session first. The design session should decompose this into child issues AFTER resolving the model decision below.
design: BLOCKING DESIGN DECISION (resolve first). device live is device-bound: every control is a live OSC write to the edit buffer. The Stadium app edits a preset structurally whether or not sound is produced. Structural editing was left out partly because it is UNKNOWN whether the Helix live protocol (2001/2002/2003) supports add/remove/move-block live. helixgen already has an offline path for structure: .hsp mutate + patch verbs + device copy. Three candidate models: (1) LIVE-ONLY structural ops over the protocol - risk: may be unsupported, needs a protocol SPIKE first (can the device add/remove/move a block live and ack it?); (2) DUAL-MODE: same UI edits the on-disk .hsp via the engine for structure/deep-editors and pushes, params stay live - reuses mature mutate path, cost is reconciling 'edit buffer' vs 'editing a file'; (3) HYBRID: live for params/bypass, offline-.hsp-then-reload for structure - simplest, but a visible 'apply structure' step breaks seamlessness. START THE DESIGN SESSION WITH THE PROTOCOL SPIKE; its answer picks the model and determines which parity items are even feasible.
acceptance_criteria: A user can build a preset's signal chain from empty to multi-path / multi-block / dual-cab, with model selection, entirely in device live - no .hsp hand-edit, no HX Edit. Structural edits persist via the existing Save/copy model and round-trip cleanly (device to-hsp <-> library) with no fidelity loss. Parity items the live protocol genuinely cannot do are documented as won't-do with the reason, not left silently missing.

title: helixgen UI → Helix Stadium Edit app parity (+ library)
description: Umbrella epic. Bring the 'helixgen device live' browser workspace to feature parity with the Line 6 Helix Stadium Edit application (the Mac/Windows desktop editor), plus the on-disk .hsp + IR library management the Stadium app has no equivalent of. Full enumeration, epic map, and the design-ready editor brief: docs/parity/stadium-app-parity.md (main checkout). Source of truth: manuals.line6.com helix-stadium 'live' rev (app v1.4 / fw v1.4). Children are the per-area epics/issues; start with the Signal-flow editor.

title: Preset / librarian management parity
description: Overlaps the existing library drawer. Gaps beyond today: templates (+folders), favorites (import/export .hls/.hsf), clones/proxy-cloning library (2048, categories, folders), batch-color, full import/export (.hsp/.hlx, setlists as one file), reorder-renumbers-MIDI-PC, preset notes/clip/search. Decide helixgen-library-first vs device-librarian-mirror. Manual: live/presets, live/librarian-view.

title: Matrix Mixer / outputs UI
description: Per-output matrix layer (1/4\"/XLR/Phones), channels (paths, song tracks, click, USB, Bluetooth, Aux), level/pan/mute/solo, per-output global EQ, reset. Larger/newer surface; lower priority unless owner uses multi-out routing. Manual: live/matrix-mixer.

title: IR management parity
description: Drawer already pushes/renames/deletes device IRs and owns the on-disk IR library (more than the Stadium app). Gaps: import WAV (auto-convert 48k/32f/mono), up to 2048 slots, folders, export, unresolved-on-delete handling, boot-reindex note. Manual: live/librarian-view (Cab IRs).

title: Global EQ UI
description: Three global EQs (1/4\", XLR, Phones), independent of presets. Pairs with the editor EQ Focus View. Manual: live/global-settings (Global EQ view).

title: Global settings / I/O / routing UI
description: Global Settings 8 categories (Ins/Outs, Switches/Pedals, Displays, Preferences, Songs, Tempo/Click, MIDI, Date/Time). Many are hardware-global not per-preset: decide how much belongs in a preset-centric editor vs a separate device-settings pane. Manual: live/global-settings.

title: Command Center UI
description: Per-preset command assignments. Sources (stomp A/B, EXP, toe, XY, Instant 1-16, ext stomps, triggers), categories (Preset/Snap, Song, Looper, Utility, Ext Amp, MIDI bank/prog/CC/note/MMC, Hotkey), actions (press/release/hold/toggle), wait, snapshot-controlled command params, copy/paste/clear, label/colour. Engine models MIDI CC/Command Center (plugin 2.26). Manual: live/command-center.

title: Song View / Showcase (WON'T-DO — owner-ratified 2026-11-24)
description: Backing-track / stem-split / playlist feature needing a purchased microSD; large surface, little overlap with helixgen tone-authoring. Flag explicit wont-do unless owner wants it. Manual: live/song-view. Owner ratified won't-do 2026-11-24; parity epic complete without it.

title: Device / utility UI
description: Connect dialog, firmware updates, remote-access PIN, rename device, licenses, account. helixgen covers discovery/backup/restore via CLI. Low UI priority. Manual: live/main-menu.

title: Tuner / tap tempo / tempo panel UI
description: Needle/strobe tuner, reference pitch, string offsets, tuner in/out; tap tempo, note-value, tempo panel. Mostly a live read/display surface. Manual: live/tuner.

title: Matrix Mixer write path (read surface found: server.mixer.state)
description: 2026-11-23 discovery sweep: the Matrix Mixer per-strip plane is READABLE over the LAN as the single structured property server.mixer.state (vol_/pan_/mute/solo/src_/name per channel; AUX/BT/Click/Count/Home paths/layer mixes). Corrects the prior 'not a property / wont-do' verdict (a dsp.matrix* glob missed a server.* blob). Remaining work is the WRITE path only: test /PropertyValueSet server.mixer.state (likely a variant/structured codec like dsp.globaleq.*), confirm on HW in a scratch value with read-back, then add a device/client.py method + `device matrix` verb. Reads need no capture. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-23-undocumented-ops-discovery-findings.md

title: Library / slot / setlist sidebar (Stadium-style)
description: Follow-on to the canvas+focus editor (shipped 0.92.0). Bring the library drawer toward the Stadium app's preset SIDEBAR: a per-setlist slot grid (1A-8D) showing what's in each slot, drag a preset slot-to-slot, and fold the on-disk .hsp library into the same surface (assign a library tone onto a slot; reconcile drift). Owner named this the next focus after editing. Manual: live/presets, live/librarian-view.

title: Canvas/focus UX pass for IR + Command Center + Global EQ panes
description: The IR/librarian (81v.7/9), Command Center (81v.4) and Global EQ (81v.6) panes shipped functionally but predate the canvas+focus reframe (0.92.0). Investigate giving them the same Stadium-parity visual treatment (category icons/accents, tile/row affordances, consistent chrome) so the whole editor reads as one system. Owner deferred these from the editor-UX reframe to track here.

title: Cross-lane block move into a split's lane B (SHIPPED — engine 0.95.0 / plugin 5.38.0)
description: SHIPPED. A bare movb into lane B orphans; bundling it with the spld/jono wiring in ONE /doAgenda commits it (agenda.move_into_split, HW-validated on a Stadium XL). Full stack: client.move_block_into_split, LiveSession.move_block_into_split (derives split/join from the buffer; accepts only the validated 1-wide, after-join shape), POST /move-into-split, and the editor drag-onto-lane-B UI. Covers the 1-wide->2-wide append; N-wide->N+1 (join-shift) and the lane-B->lane-A inverse remain follow-ups. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-24-cross-lane-move-hw-capture-findings.md.

title: Comp/dynamics gain-reduction meter — INFEASIBLE (no per-block telemetry)
description: INFEASIBLE — HW-confirmed 2026-11-25, correcting an earlier premature 'feasible' note. The 2003 /dspEvent stream carries only two envelope arrays (eid 1 mid 796 and mid 800) plus the tuner (eid 10) — no other eid/mid. mid-796's ~34 populated cells are NOT per-grid-node: a bypass-diff of a 5-block series chain showed bypassing ANY block changes the SAME cell set (8,9,14-31) — they are chain-level input + downstream/output taps, not per-block levels. A comp's gain reduction needs its own input-minus-output level at that block, which the device does not expose on any stream. Close unless a future firmware adds per-block telemetry.

title: Dual-cab 2nd-cab parameter writes (SHIPPED — engine 0.96.0 / plugin 5.39.0)
description: SHIPPED. The 2nd cab was read-only (hgc-5gh: no known live-write address). HW-RE 2026-11-25: /ParamValueSet already carries a sub index (hardcoded 0); sub=1 writes the 2nd cab's params (HW-confirmed: Angle 45->50, 1st cab untouched; echo field4 is the sub, confirmed across snapshots 0/2/5). Shipped: client.set_param(sub=), LiveSession.set_second_cab_param, POST /second-cab-param, editable 2nd-cab knobs keyed path/block/s1/pid, decode_event drops sub!=0 echoes. Adversarial-reviewed (undo-routing + echo-misroute fixed).

title: Amp-lens 5-zone morph — NOT a Stadium gap (mischaracterization, HW-verified)
description: RESOLVED — not a real parity gap. Inspected the Helix Stadium app's amp block editor directly 2026-11-25 (Brit 2203MV on preset 11B): it is a STANDARD parameter editor — Jack/Drive/Bass/Mid/Treble/Presence/Master/Level, viewable as sliders OR knobs via a header toggle. There is NO '5-zone morph lens' or '8 lens positions' in Stadium's amp editor. The '5 zones morphing multiple params / store 8 positions as snapshots 1-8' came from the 81v.1 spec (section 8.4), which the parity map itself flagged as a likely mis-map (lens zones != scenes). helixgen's focus editor already shows the amp's full param set (parity) AND adds a Drive x Level XY lens pad Stadium does not have — so helixgen matches and exceeds Stadium's amp editor. Only micro-difference: Stadium offers a slider-view toggle (helixgen is knobs-only) — a trivial optional enhancement, not a parity gap.

title: Amp 'Based On' model info — WON'T-DO (no basis metadata)
description: Stadium shows the real amp a model is based on. helixgen's model data carries only internal names (model_name_for -> 'Agoura_AmpBrit2203MV'); there is no 'based-on' field in the defs. Not surfaceable. Document as won't-do.

title: Clone/Capture metadata panel — WON'T-DO (no Capture-block support)
description: Stadium shows Brand/Product/UUID/Notes/date for Capture (Clone) blocks. helixgen's engine defs/modelmap have no Capture/Clone block support — Captures are user-created amp/cab snapshots not modeled here. Document as won't-do (out of the engine's data scope).

title: Amp>Cab Link indicator/toggle — WON'T-DO for now (undecoded preset structure, RE-gated)
description: Stadium's cab editor shows an Amp>Cab Link indicator/toggle. The CabIdx datum exists on Agoura amps but is treated as internal (transcode.py), and the Amp>Cab Link setting lives in the preset structure the topology-synthesis design doc flags as NOT yet decoded (Trails / Amp>Cab Link / block-type defaults). Replicating it needs protocol RE of that structure. Document as won't-do-for-now; revisit if that structure gets decoded.

title: Cab IR frequency-response plot — WON'T-DO for built-in cabs; niche for user IRs
description: Stadium plots a cab/IR's frequency response. For a BUILT-IN cab (the common case) the impulse is internal to the device DSP and not extractable by a third-party tool (only CabIdx + AmpCabZFir flags are exposed), so the plot can't be computed. For a user IR-loader block the IR file is accessible and an FFT plot IS buildable, but that is niche. Document built-in-cab case as won't-do; user-IR plot as an optional niche follow-up. UPDATE 2026-11-25: the USER-IR case is now SHIPPED (see 81v.25, core 0.98.0) — the IR-loader block's hash resolves to the user's local .wav and is FFT'd with zero new deps. The BUILT-IN cab case remains won't-do (impulse DSP-internal).

title: Knobs/sliders view toggle in the editor (SHIPPED — engine 0.97.0 / plugin 5.40.0)
description: SHIPPED. Stadium's editor renders continuous params as horizontal sliders; the live editor previously had knobs only. Added an isolated slider() control reusing the shared reg/queue/record write path (knob() untouched — zero regression risk), a persisted KNOBVIEW global ('knobs'|'sliders'), a header toggle, and lens-highlight parity on the slider fill. control() branches on KNOBVIEW for continuous params only; toggles/selects unaffected. Tests: S45 scenario (renders, horizontal drag writes + one undo step + carries rev, no-op click writes nothing) + 270 liveedit pytest. HW-validated against Stadium XL (amp controls as live sliders). Adversarial-reviewed: sound, no real defects.

title: User-IR frequency-response plot in the editor (SHIPPED — engine 0.98.0 / plugin 5.41.0)
description: SHIPPED. Stadium's cab editor plots a loaded IR's frequency response. For a user IR (an 'ir'-category loader block, HX2_ImpulseResponseWithPan) the impulse is in the user's local IR library, so helixgen reads it and plots it (built-in cabs stay won't-do, 81v.23). Zero new deps (device extra has no numpy/libsndfile): new liveedit/irplot.py = stdlib wave reader (8/16/24/32-bit PCM, stereo->mono, rejects float, caps the read) + iterative radix-2 FFT + fractional-octave-smoothed, peak-normalised, log-spaced magnitude. chain.py surfaces the block's content hash (mdls[0].irmd->hex) as ir_hash; session.ir_response resolves it via IrMapping to the local .wav; POST /ir-response (read-only, no device I/O); an SVG curve on the focused IR block with friendly notes for the misses (IR not in local library / empty / moved file). Tests: FFT vs numpy ~1e-13, wav formats incl. missing/moved file, chain surfacing, session + route all paths. HW-validated (real cab curve on the device). Adversarial-reviewed: one bug (moved IR -> uncaught FileNotFoundError) fixed, re-reviewed clean.

title: Block copy/paste in the editor (SHIPPED — engine 0.99.0 / plugin 5.42.0)
description: SHIPPED. Copy captures a block's model/params/bypass/2nd-cab into a page clipboard; Paste appends a duplicate on the focused path and reproduces that state via session.paste_block (add_block + set_param*N + set_second_cab(+param) + set_bypass) and POST /paste-block. Appends only — the engine has no insert-and-shift (move_block swaps). Adversarial review fixed two silent-partial-success issues: a mid-paste device failure (502) now surfaces instead of being swallowed like a pid-skip, and the pasted slot is taken from add_block's exact slot, not a fragile diff. UI wiring validated on HW.

title: Serial 2nd+ parallel split in the editor (SHIPPED — engine 0.100.0 / plugin 5.42.0)
description: SHIPPED + HW-VALIDATED. The 2-row grid can't nest a parallel lane but holds sections in SERIES; add_split refused any 2nd split. Relaxed the guard: a 2nd (3rd…) split is allowed past the last routing node (split AND join columns, matched by category so all four split models 474-477 count — a review-found bug) when its lane-B slots (col+14/+15) are free. split_out's geometry is already correct for any column (bblk=14+col, the known-good offline rule) and leaves earlier sections untouched. HW-validated on a Stadium XL: built a series, split once, split again past the join -> two serial sections (split@2/join@3/laneB@16 + split@4/join@5/laneB@18); device restored clean. Adversarial-reviewed; the one risky unknown (coexisting split wirings) resolved on HW.

title: Clear-Path-B / collapse a parallel lane — WON'T-DO (no unsplit op; clrb HW-disproven)
description: WON'T-DO. Removing the split/join routing nodes to collapse a parallel lane back to series is impossible: the clrb op is HW-disproven (exhaustively 2026-11-22 — standalone clrb, the remove-split compound, instance-id addressing, type fields all no-ops), and there is no unsplit/merge op. Block removal only nulls a block (/ModelSet->Null), leaving a hole; it cannot drop a routing node.

title: Convert a block mono↔stereo in place (SHIPPED — engine 0.101.0 / plugin 5.43.0)
description: SHIPPED. CORRECTS an earlier won't-do. App-side verification of the Stadium editor (driven directly) showed its model browser HAS Mono/Stereo/Legacy tabs and that mono/stereo twins DO exist — 158 base names carry both a Mono and a Stereo model (the earlier data analysis wrongly claimed zero). So convert = same-category swap to the twin. defs.mono_stereo_twin (suffix swap, in-category guard, 316 models); session.convert_mono_stereo captures params by NAME, swap_model to the twin, re-applies shared params (pids differ; mono set is a subset of stereo). chain ms_form; page ⇄ button; POST /convert-mono-stereo. HW-validated on a Stadium XL (DistRamsHeadMono->Stereo, Level carried). Adversarial review fixed a swallowed-502 bug (same as paste); re-reviewed sound.

title: Model-browser Mono/Stereo/Legacy subcategory tabs — WON'T-DO (classification data absent)
description: WON'T-DO (app-demonstrated). Stadium's model browser HAS Mono/Stereo/Legacy subcategory tabs (verified by driving the app). They can't be faithfully built: Mono/Stereo is derivable from the model-name suffix, BUT legacy models also carry mono/stereo suffixes (e.g. HD2_DL4AnalogDelayStereo sits in Stadium's Legacy tab, not Stereo), so a suffix filter MISFILES every legacy model — and the Legacy set is absent from the vendored defs (catalog entries carry only category id/name/short). No correct 3-tab filter without the Legacy classification.

title: Trails + harness settings in the editor — WON'T-DO (harness node, no live-write address)
description: WON'T-DO for the live editor. Trails lives on the fx harness node (P35_AppFxHarnessTrails{Mono,Stereo}); the default harness emitted per effect can't even hold Trails. The harness is read-only in the live editor with no decoded live-write address (hgc-5gh/hgc-mn3/hgc-1yx) — same RE wall as Amp>Cab Link. Partly addressable OFFLINE only.

title: Trails (spillover) On/Off in the live editor — SHIPPED (core 0.102.0)
description: RESOLVED and shipped in core 0.102.0 — supersedes the earlier won't-do. Trails lives on the block's fx-harness node (P35_AppFxHarness*), not the model, so it has no param-grid address. Its live-write path /HarnessParamValueSet (harness pid 1, no sub field) was decoded via a frida capture of the Stadium Edit app and HW-validated on a Stadium XL. The live editor now exposes an On/Off set-control on every delay/reverb block (chain.trails_capable, session.set_trails, /trails route, client.set_harness_param via the fast path). Write-only: the device accepts the write but does not expose Trails state to read back (absent from both sfg_ and _sbepgsm, no Get), so it is a fire-and-forget SET, not a reflected toggle — a device read-limitation, not a helixgen gap.

title: Amp>Cab Link — NOT an editor-view feature (Global Settings preference), out of scope
description: RECLASSIFIED from the earlier 'RE-gated won't-do'. App-side verification (IR loader + built-in cab) shows Amp>Cab Link is a Global Settings PREFERENCE that governs cab routing globally, not an amp or cab block param — the amp's full param list has no link control. It is therefore outside the device-live EDITOR-VIEW scope entirely, not a parity gap to close and not RE-gated. No work owed.
